purpose: Sparse actual-skin edge constraints for mounted cape projection
index_space: Zero-based vertex indices concatenated in runtime fit surface order
analysis_skin_policy: Edge selection uses the original approved geometry and 17 source palette slots; this is the selection search context, not the final mounted attachment policy.

runtime_policy.attachment_reference: Canonical skeleton global-rest palettes; independent of first received gait or action
runtime_policy.selected_attachment: spine_neck; body slot 12 uses spine_03 and its original slot-12 bind; slots 13 through 16 use neck_01 and its original slot-15 bind
runtime_policy.alternative_adapter_modes: head_neck, rigid_neck and rigid_spine remain available for comparison; they are not the selected mounted runtime policy
runtime_policy.root_reference: Canonical spine skin frame, with zero root translations
runtime_policy.root_frame: G(current body frames) * inverse(G(canonical body frames)) * canonical spine frame

root_blend.G: Normalized quaternion blend of Spine and Neck, translated to preserve their blended transformed material centroid
root_blend.material_centroid: Mounted rest vertex centroid weighted by that root control, plus its idle translation
root_blend.canonical_normalization: The same fraction and material centroid define both current G and canonical G; the canonical root frame remains exactly the source spine frame

runtime_policy.mounted_variant: Pure rebasing preserves the canonical source rendered reference under the Spine/Neck attachment. Runtime-selected shoulder relief then deliberately adds bounded clearance; it is an intentional fit change, separate from rebase precision.

intentional_relief.coordinate_space: Original approved native anatomical vertex positions
intentional_relief.interpolation: Quintic smootherstep; normals use the warp inverse transpose and tangents its forward Jacobian
intentional_relief.fixed_scope: These regions receive zero deliberate relief; they are not fixed in world space. The neckline follows its anatomical neck skin frame during motion.

error_contract.pure_rebase_error_m: Precision of the canonical rebase before intentional relief
error_contract.reference_error_m: Precision against the canonical reference plus the explicit intentional relief target
error_contract.no_relief_default: The adapter default remains zero relief and preserves the original rendered reference

runtime_policy.preserved: Original eight influence values and bone indices, UVs, topology, materials and body skeleton poses
runtime_policy.edge_denominators: Original approved source positions, not rebased mounted positions
runtime_policy.on_foot: Original approved mesh, skin and motion are restored unchanged
runtime_policy.validation: Dense native geometry qualification of the selected mounted attachment remains authoritative

recipe.algorithm: Actual native critical edges, minimax radial support near the 1.65 strain boundary across four cape angles, then broad control-target and material-region support
recipe.qualification_limit: Sampling coverage is measured on original approved rest plus idle data with the listed analysis controls. The selected rigid mounted attachment is a separate variant; this selection does not certify arbitrary body poses, full-mesh strain or clearance. Dense native runtime checks remain required.

radial_boundary_coverage.scope: Fully cape-owned panel and actual native mixed-collar critical edges. Coverage is sampled, not a proof for every body pose; dense runtime qualification remains authoritative.
